title: Hand Dryer Bina Dekhe Kaise Chalta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Hand dryer aapka haath dekhta nahi, phir bhi chalta hai! Kaise? Chaliye andar ka sensor dekhte hain.
🔦 IR LED aur receiver ki jodi kaise kaam karti hai
📡 Haath se IR echo wapas kaise aata hai
⚙️ Control board fan aur heater ko kab chalu karta hai
✨ Sheesha, steel aur dhoop dryer ko kaise bewakoof banate hain
🧽 Dryer khud chale to kya karein
Aisi aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
